== English errata source comparison ==
The Glossary and Supplement say using defense value of 4; the later PC face and Appendix A say as if a character with defense value of 4. Both wordings are retained. The current GEMP constructor still uses the Decipher wording, so existing 2_139 remains on that state. The PC documentary article has no allocated gameplay ID. The later PC image is placed on its matching wording. Sources: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]]; [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher Glossary Supplement]]; [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A.
